messages:
Felix (marketing): FYI saw ~22 HubSpot leads marked unowned at 09:02 PT, missing enrichment flag. Heads-up to revops/ops.
Nina (revops): Checking webhooks  enrich service returned 502s for some batched requests. Our RR lambda checks `lead_enriched` on first delivery and gives up after 2m.
Arun (ops): Quick mitigation: route leads without `lead_enriched=true` into `rr-fallback` and set property `routed_via=fallback_enrich` + FF bump claim_window 120s->300s. Roll canary 5%->100%.
Bea (sales): Thumbs. Please add visible HS timeline note "Fallback routed - enrichment delayed" so reps don't duplicate outreach.
leadflow-bot: alert: enrich-service /bulk 5xx spike 0.3%->9.4% (08:56-09:06 PT). Auto-backoff applied.
Nina (revops): I'll tag cohort `enrich-3755553333` for dashboards and capture `time_to_owner`.
Arun (ops): Canary started at 09:12 PT, monitoring: https://grafana.redwood/d/leadflow/routing.
Felix (marketing): I'll pause webinar automations that rely on enrichment tags and send a short rep note to #sales-ops.
Arun (ops): Canary healthy at 09:18 PT; rolling to 100%. Keeping claim_window=300s for 60m then reassess.
Nina (revops): Incident INC-2026-9812 opened. Postmortem owner and SLA proposal assigned.
Felix (marketing): Thanks team 44d. Keep updates here.
